sentences.en: A bat flying in the sky looks like a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 天空中飞着一只蝙蝠，看起来像只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: When you're enjoying yourself, the time seems to fly by.
sentences.zh: 你玩得正开心的时候，时间就像飞逝了一样。

sentences.en: The homeless people were annoyed by the flies and mosquitoes.
sentences.zh: 无家可归的人被苍蝇和蚊子烦扰。

senses.zh: 飞，飞行过得快，飞逝，(动作)疾驰(旗)飘荡，飘扬碎成片
